title: Lambda triggers and event sources
hook: Lambda integrates with S3, API Gateway, SQS, EventBridge, DynamoDB streams, and more — each trigger differs in invoke mode, batching, and retry semantics.

blocks.text: Lambda triggers include synchronous invokes (API Gateway, ALB Lambda target) returning errors to caller, and asynchronous invokes (S3, SNS, EventBridge) with automatic retry and optional Dead Letter Queue (DLQ). Event source mappings poll Amazon SQS, Kinesis, and DynamoDB streams with batching and partial failure responses.

entries.plainDefinition: Caller waits for response — API Gateway, direct invoke.
Lambda queues invoke, retries twice, then DLQ.
Lambda polls stream/queue and invokes with batch.
Destination for failed async invokes after retries.
entries.example: SQS queue captures failed S3 processor events.

blocks.text: Wrong invoke type expectations — S3 trigger does not block upload on handler failure. SQS mapping needs ReportBatchItemFailures for partial batch retry. API Gateway 502 when unhandled exception in sync invoke.

blocks.title: Interview framing
blocks.body: Say: sync vs async invoke. Event source mapping for queues/streams. S3 async at-least-once. API Gateway sync timeout 29s integration limit.

diagram.source:
flowchart TB
  APIGW[API Gateway] -->|sync| L[Lambda]

snippet.label: SQS event source mapping
snippet.code:
Mapping:
  Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
  Properties:
    FunctionName: !Ref Worker
    EventSourceArn: !GetAtt WorkQueue.Arn
    BatchSize: 10
    MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 5
    FunctionResponseTypes:
      - ReportBatchItemFailures
snippet.explanation: Partial batch failure returns failed message IDs only for retry.

snippet.label: EventBridge rule target Lambda
snippet.code:
OrderRule:
  Type: AWS::Events::Rule
  Properties:
    EventPattern:
      source: [custom.orders]
      detail-type: [OrderPlaced]
    Targets:
      - Arn: !GetAtt OrderHandler.Arn
        Id: OrderLambda
Permission:
  Type: AWS::Lambda::Permission
  Properties:
    Action: lambda:InvokeFunction
    FunctionName: !Ref OrderHandler
    Principal: events.amazonaws.com
    SourceArn: !GetAtt OrderRule.Arn
snippet.explanation: EventBridge needs Lambda permission for events.amazonaws.com principal.

blocks.title: Pitfalls to avoid
blocks.body: Expecting S3 to retry until handler succeeds — async retries then DLQ only. SQS mapping without partial batch failure duplicates successful records. API Gateway timeout shorter than Lambda timeout causes 504.

blocks.text: EventBridge Pipes connect sources to targets with transformation. Kinesis enhanced fan-out for multiple consumers. How to prove it in production: IteratorAge for streams, ApproximateAgeOfOldestMessage for queue, DLQ alarm, API Gateway 5xx vs Lambda Errors correlation.

blocks.title: What gets you rejected in interviews
blocks.body: Treating S3 trigger as sync blocking upload gets rejected. Strong answer: async retry + DLQ + idempotent handler.

interviewTakeaways: Sync invokes return errors to caller; async retries then DLQ.
Event source mappings poll SQS/Kinesis with batching options.
S3 events at-least-once — idempotent processing required.
60s: API sync. S3 async + DLQ. SQS mapping with partial batch failure. EventBridge filtered async.
Follow-up: difference mapping DLQ vs function DLQ?
commonPitfalls: Strong answer: idempotent on key; async retries twice then DLQ.
SQS whole batch retry on one failure without ReportBatchItemFailures.
Lambda timeout > API Gateway integration timeout.
